title: Yacht Guitar Orchestra
summary: Rubella and Lillith sunbathing on a yacht while a guitar line plays the rail. Three-song hard-cut journey in twenty silent Imagine scenes (about 3:24, working times): daylight vine island with guitar orchestra bed, dark island fire with Wallisian bed, night approach to Busan Gwangan Bridge with Korean K-pop bed. Every mouth stays closed, the vocals are off-picture. No landing.
visualArc: Open ocean lounges + guitar line → the sway, prow and wake, a chord ripple down the necks → sunglasses reflect the vine island → shore cannons, a pick over the rail, one dolphin leap, too many parrots → hard cut dark: lights in the vines, beach fire, faces and a cannon in firelight, the parrots leave, the lounges in the dark → hard cut night: Busan Gwangan Bridge RGB + Marine City, light on the hull, the ring from above, a strip of black water that never closes.
